Definition: from a derivative of G1349; a judger:--judge.
BiblicalUsage: A judge, and in Acts it is Moses, whom Israel rejected with the words about who made him a ruler and a judge, yet God sent him as both ruler and deliverer.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the judge Israel rejected was the deliverer God had chosen, and I take care not to dismiss the one God sends to save me.
